name: Marble Royale
tagline: Build traps. Race rivals. Last marble wins.
kicker: Async marble battle royale for Android
summary: Eight marbles, four rounds, one crown. Everyone drops traps on the same track at the same time, then the race reveals what you built. Tilt to steer, dodge the traps and be the last marble rolling.
description: Every round starts with a build: pick a trap and drop it on the course. Bumpers, mud pits, spinners, peg fields, spike strips and more. Then the track is revealed with everyone's traps in place, and the race is on. Only the fastest marbles qualify for the next round, and a trap that cracks a rival pays off.

Tilt your phone to steer. Carve lines through the bends, ride wall rides, loops, tubes and corkscrews, grab sparks for a dash and brace before a hit. Each round runs on a fresh course in one of 15 worlds, from deep space to a toy room.

Matches are asynchronous: the other marbles are recorded runs of real players, so you never wait in a lobby. Add friends with a code, send challenges, climb the ranked leagues, and collect skins, trails and shatter effects as you go.

features.title: Trap your rivals
features.text: Everyone builds at the same time, then the reveal shows the whole course. Your traps keep paying while you race.

features.title: Tilt to steer
features.text: Lean the phone to carve the bends, then tap DASH to overtake and hold BRACE to survive a hit.

features.title: A new track every round
features.text: Courses are generated for every round: loops, corkscrews, tubes, bowls, funnels, plinko boards and more.

features.title: 15 worlds
features.text: Race through deep space, an ice cave, a clockwork workshop, a toy room, a volcano forge, a haunted manor and ten more.

features.title: No waiting
features.text: Rivals are recorded runs of real players, so a match starts the moment you tap PLAY. Your own runs race in other players' matches.

features.title: Friends and leagues
features.text: Add friends with a code, send challenges, climb the ranked leagues and collect skins, trails and shatter effects.

data: Your progress and settings are saved on your phone. Online play uses an anonymous account tied to a random ID for your device: no e-mail, no sign-in.

To delete your online account and everything linked to it (name, friends, challenges, recorded runs, ranked history), open Settings ▸ Delete online account in the game, or email us from any address with your racer name and friend code. Progress saved on your phone stays until you uninstall the game.
The game has no ads and no analytics. Bought something that didn't arrive? Email us with the Google Play order number. Refunds go through Google Play.
